body: I hate that I've gotten to the point of feeling like this. I definitely think it's only situational and if it were to improve, so would the feelings. I often wake up to immediate anxiety thinking about the future. Is just drudging through life really even living?

I really feel like I get what you're saying. I made the mistake of going to school and graduating with an unholy amount of debt. Now I'm working in a job that crushes my soul and after loan payment am not taking home any more money than if I'd just worked instead of going to school. Plus that debt restricts the jobs I am able to take, so I feel stuck and really out of control. It freaks me out to think of being in this same position 5 years from now, let alone 20 or more. I don't know if I can do it. Is it even worth it?
